sources.title: Venice SD35 by Stability AI — Image Generation | VeniceStats
sources.snippet: Venice SD35 is Venice's self-hosted, privacy-preserving text-to-image model, built on Stability AI's open-source Stable Diffusion 3.5 architecture. Introduced as the default model in Venice Image Engine V2 in March 2025, it wraps the base SD 3.5 weights in a custom-configured engine powered by a ComfyUI workflow backend.
